entities.summary: Vladimir Yevgenyevich Sokolov was a Russian scientist in the field of zoology and ecology. He was a member of the Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union, Russian Academy of Sciences and the Brundtland Commission. He was one of the pioneers of the Russian environmentalism movement and one of the early global sustainability advocates.
